definitions.full: H2488. chalitsah [ חֲלִיצָה ] noun feminine what is stripped off a person, as plunder, in war; — only suffix חֲלִצָתוֺ 2Sam 2:21 ; חֲלִיצוֺתָם Judg 14:19 .
